By continuing, you agree that this company device will run Lead Logger, which:

 • Reads this device's call log (number, time, duration, direction) and SMS messages (sender/recipient number, time, and message body)
 • Uploads that data to the company's lead-tracking system so follow-ups on customer calls and texts aren't missed
 • Shows a permanent notification whenever monitoring is active — it cannot run hidden
 • Is used only for work-related lead follow-up, on a device your employer owns or has assigned to you for work

 You can ask your manager to stop monitoring or sign out at any time from the app's home screen, which immediately stops all capture and uploads.
Lead Logger needs Call Log and SMS permissions to do its job. Grant them to continue.
